title: WPMS/239/1994 of STATE OF U.P. Vs CHIEF CONTROLLING REVENUE AUTHORITY and ORS

paras.text:
WPMS 178/2003
Honíble P.C. Verma, J.
Sri Gopal Narain, learned Brief
Holder for the petitioner.
The matter pertains to the year
1994.
Learned Brief Holder for the
petitioner made a statement that he
has no paper book and in the absence
of paper book, he cannot prosecute the
case. Therefore, the writ petition is
dismissed for non-prosecution.
Interim order, if any, shall stand
vacated.
 (P.C.V., J.)
25.6.2008
Prabodh
